judge_notes: Both reviews say the effective Hamiltonian cannot tell separated Majoranas from quasi-Majoranas (overlapping components), so I counted both quasi-majorana-smooth-confinement and local-probe-loophole, even though the paper's quasi-Majoranas do not come from smooth confinement. B's 'parity qubit built from conventional ABS or YSR states' was counted as abs-quantum-dot. protocol-parameter-sensitivity covers the envelope and fit-range choices and the 25 ns ramp and time-resolution limits on the charge-qubit comparison.
